description:
This file defines the 'CheckoutActivity' class for an Android Kotlin app, representing a checkout screen in an online shopping platform. It manages user input for customer details, shipping address, payment methods, and coupons. The class interacts with a ViewModel to handle data binding, validation, UI state, and order submission, and it contains UI setup and event handling logic.

Search terms are selected to distinguish this file within the project, focusing on its specific class name, package, and key components.

classes.name: CheckoutActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class representing the checkout screen. It handles user input, UI updates through data binding, interaction with the ViewModel, and order submission logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, listeners, and binds state from the ViewModel.

methods.name: setupToolbar
methods.description: Configures the toolbar with a title and back navigation.

methods.name: setupPaymentMethodUi
methods.description: Preselects the payment method radio button based on ViewModel state.

methods.name: setupFormListeners
methods.description: Attaches text change and click listeners to form inputs and buttons.

methods.name: setupCouponSuggestions
methods.description: Configures dropdown suggestions for coupon codes.

methods.name: setupPaymentValidationPolish
methods.description: Enhances user experience with focus change animations and accessibility cues for form validation.

methods.name: bindState
methods.description: Binds activity UI components to the ViewModel's flow data streams, managing UI state reactively.

methods.name: setLoading
methods.description: Manages UI to reflect loading state during order submission.

methods.name: setAllEnabled
methods.description: Recursively enables or disables all views in a view hierarchy.

methods.name: showManageSavedCouponsDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog listing saved coupons, allowing selection or removal.
